_about: Revision 3 of journey-routes, written on 2026-10-25 and not yet pushed (a dry run against skku_content passed; skku_content_dev refuses its 7800 rides while bus_campus_dev stores no 7800 registry route): revision 2 plus the 종로 08 → 종로5가 → 1호선 and the 4호선 → 사당 → 7800 options each way (ADR 0022 D7, docs/plans/transit-route-planner.md PR (g)), each pole cited by its nine-digit station id; each new walk measured with TMAP pedestrian routing (POST /tmap/routes/pedestrian, WGS84GEO) on 2026-10-25 between the points its evidence names, its path rounded to six decimals; the walks to and from 혜화 and 성균관대 are revision 2's; subway ride fallback minutes from subway-timetables revision 3, bus ride fallback minutes from TOPIS getArrInfoByRouteAll captured 2026-10-25.
